controles.web: The oracle which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
controles.kjv: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.
controles.livre: Revelação que o profeta Habacuque viu.

versos.hebraico: עַד־אָ֧נָה יְהוָ֛ה שִׁוַּ֖עְתִּי וְלֹ֣א תִשְׁמָ֑ע אֶזְעַ֥ק אֵלֶ֛יךָ חָמָ֖ס וְלֹ֥א תוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

controles.web: Yahweh, how long will I cry, and you will not hear? I cry out to you “Violence!” and will you not save?
controles.kjv: O Lord, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!
controles.livre: Até quando, SENHOR, eu clamarei, e tu não ouvirás? Até quando gritarei a ti: Violência!, e tu não salvarás?

versos.hebraico: לָ֣מָּה תַרְאֵ֤נִי אָ֨וֶן֙ וְעָמָ֣ל תַּבִּ֔יט וְשֹׁ֥ד וְחָמָ֖ס לְנֶגְדִּ֑י וַיְהִ֧י רִ֦יב וּמָד֖וֹן יִשָּֽׂא׃

controles.web: Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and contention rises up.
controles.kjv: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.
controles.livre: Por que me fazes ver a injustiça, e vês a opressão? Pois assolação e violência estão em frente de mim, há brigas, e disputas se levantam.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּן֙ תָּפ֣וּג תּוֹרָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־יֵצֵ֥א לָנֶ֖צַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט כִּ֤י רָשָׁע֙ מַכְתִּ֣יר אֶת־הַצַּדִּ֔יק עַל־כֵּ֛ן יֵצֵ֥א מִשְׁפָּ֖ט מְעֻקָּֽל׃

controles.web: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.
controles.kjv: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.
controles.livre: Por isso que a lei é enfraquecida, e o juízo nunca se cumpre: porque o perverso cerca o justo, por o juízo é distorcido.

versos.hebraico: רְא֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ וְֽהַבִּ֔יטוּ וְהִֽתַּמְּה֖וּ תְּמָ֑הוּ כִּי־פֹ֨עַל֙ פֹּעֵ֣ל בִּֽימֵיכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַאֲמִ֖ינוּ כִּ֥י יְסֻפָּֽר׃

controles.web: “Look among the nations, watch, and wonder marvelously; for I am working a work in your days, which you will not believe though it is told you.
controles.kjv: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.
controles.livre: Vede entre as nações, e prestai atenção, e espantai-vos,  espantai-vos; porque uma obra será feita em vossos dias, que quando for contada, não acreditareis.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־הִנְנִ֤י מֵקִים֙ אֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים הַגּ֖וֹי הַמַּ֣ר וְהַנִּמְהָ֑ר הַֽהוֹלֵךְ֙ לְמֶרְחֲבֵי־אֶ֔רֶץ לָרֶ֖שֶׁת מִשְׁכָּנ֥וֹת לֹּא־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: For, behold, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the breadth of the earth, to possess dwelling places that are not theirs.
controles.kjv: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.
controles.livre: Porque eis que eu levanto os caldeus, uma nação amarga e veloz, que caminha pelas larguras da terra para tomar posse de moradas que não são suas.

versos.hebraico: אָיֹ֥ם וְנוֹרָ֖א ה֑וּא מִמֶּ֕נּוּ מִשְׁפָּט֥וֹ וּשְׂאֵת֖וֹ יֵצֵֽא׃

controles.web: They are feared and dreaded. Their judgment and their dignity proceed from themselves.
controles.kjv: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
controles.livre: Ela é espantosa é e terrível; que impõe seu próprio julgamento e sua própria honra.

versos.hebraico: וְקַלּ֨וּ מִנְּמֵרִ֜ים סוּסָ֗יו וְחַדּוּ֙ מִזְּאֵ֣בֵי עֶ֔רֶב וּפָ֖שׁוּ פָּֽרָשָׁ֑יו וּפָֽרָשָׁיו֙ מֵרָח֣וֹק יָבֹ֔אוּ יָעֻ֕פוּ כְּנֶ֖שֶׁר חָ֥שׁ לֶאֱכֽוֹל׃

controles.web: Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen come from afar. They fly as an eagle that hurries to devour.
controles.kjv: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.
controles.livre: E seus cavalos são mais rápidos que os leopardos, e mais ferozes que lobos de tarde; e seus cavaleiros avançam; seus cavaleiros virão de longe, e voarão como águias que se apressam para devorar.

versos.hebraico: כֻּלֹּה֙ לְחָמָ֣ס יָב֔וֹא מְגַמַּ֥ת פְּנֵיהֶ֖ם קָדִ֑ימָה וַיֶּאֱסֹ֥ף כַּח֖וֹל שֶֽׁבִי׃

controles.web: All of them come for violence. Their hordes face the desert. He gathers prisoners like sand.
controles.kjv: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.
controles.livre: Todos eles vêm para fazer violência; seus rostos estão orientados;  e juntarão cativos como areia.

versos.hebraico: וְהוּא֙ בַּמְּלָכִ֣ים יִתְקַלָּ֔ס וְרֹזְנִ֖ים מִשְׂחָ֣ק ל֑וֹ ה֚וּא לְכָל־מִבְצָ֣ר יִשְׂחָ֔ק וַיִּצְבֹּ֥ר עָפָ֖ר וַֽיִּלְכְּדָֽהּ׃

controles.web: Yes, he scoffs at kings, and princes are a derision to him. He laughs at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen ramp, and takes it.
controles.kjv: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.
controles.livre: E escarnecerão dos reis, e zombarão dos príncipes; rirão de todas as fortalezas, porque amontoarão terra, e as tomarão.

versos.hebraico: אָ֣ז חָלַ֥ף ר֛וּחַ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר וְאָשֵׁ֑ם ז֥וּ כֹח֖וֹ לֵאלֹהֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Then he sweeps by like the wind, and goes on. He is indeed guilty, whose strength is his god.”
controles.kjv: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.
controles.livre: Logo mudarão, e passarão adiante como o vento; porém culpado será quem confiar na força de seu deus.

versos.hebraico: הֲל֧וֹא אַתָּ֣ה מִקֶּ֗דֶם יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛י קְדֹשִׁ֖י לֹ֣א נָמ֑וּת יְהוָה֙ לְמִשְׁפָּ֣ט שַׂמְתּ֔וֹ וְצ֖וּר לְהוֹכִ֥יחַ יְסַדְתּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Aren’t you from everlasting, Yahweh my God, my Holy One? We will not die. Yahweh, you have appointed him for judgment. You, Rock, have established him to punish.
controles.kjv: Art thou not from everlasting, O Lord my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.
controles.livre: Não és tu desde o princípio, ó SENHOR, meu Deus, meu Santo? Não morreremos. Ó SENHOR, tu os puseste para executar o julgamento; e tu, ó Rocha, os estabeleceste para castigar.

versos.hebraico: טְה֤וֹר עֵינַ֨יִם֙ מֵרְא֣וֹת רָ֔ע וְהַבִּ֥יט אֶל־עָמָ֖ל לֹ֣א תוּכָ֑ל לָ֤מָּה תַבִּיט֙ בּֽוֹגְדִ֔ים תַּחֲרִ֕ישׁ בְּבַלַּ֥ע רָשָׁ֖ע צַדִּ֥יק מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: You who have purer eyes than to see evil, and who cannot look on perversity, why do you tolerate those who deal treacherously, and keep silent when the wicked swallows up the man who is more righteous than he,
controles.kjv: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
controles.livre: Teus olhos são puros demais para veres o mal, e não podes observar a opressão; ora, por que olharias aos enganadores, e calarias quando o perverso devora ao mais justo que ele?

versos.hebraico: וַתַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֖ם כִּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם כְּרֶ֖מֶשׂ לֹא־מֹשֵׁ֥ל בּֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and make men like the fish of the sea, like the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
controles.kjv: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?
controles.livre: Tornarias as pessoas como como os peixes do mar, como répteis que não têm quem os governe?

versos.hebraico: כֻּלֹּה֙ בְּחַכָּ֣ה הֵֽעֲלָ֔ה יְגֹרֵ֣הוּ בְחֶרְמ֔וֹ וְיַאַסְפֵ֖הוּ בְּמִכְמַרְתּ֑וֹ עַל־כֵּ֖ן יִשְׂמַ֥ח וְיָגִֽיל׃

controles.web: He takes up all of them with the hook. He catches them in his net, and gathers them in his dragnet. Therefore he rejoices and is glad.
controles.kjv: They take up all of them with the angle, they catch them in their net, and gather them in their drag: therefore they rejoice and are glad.
controles.livre: Ele tira a todos com anzol, em sua malha os ajunta, e os colhe em seu rede; por isso ele se alegra e tem prazer.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּן֙ יְזַבֵּ֣חַ לְחֶרְמ֔וֹ וִֽיקַטֵּ֖ר לְמִכְמַרְתּ֑וֹ כִּ֤י בָהֵ֨מָּה֙ שָׁמֵ֣ן חֶלְק֔וֹ וּמַאֲכָל֖וֹ בְּרִאָֽה׃

controles.web: Therefore he sacrifices to his net, and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious, and his food is good.
controles.kjv: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.
controles.livre: Por isso ele faz sacrifícios à sua malha, e oferece incensos à sua rede; porque com elas enriqueceu sua porção, e engordou sua comida.

versos.hebraico: הַ֥עַל כֵּ֖ן יָרִ֣יק חֶרְמ֑וֹ וְתָמִ֛יד לַהֲרֹ֥ג גּוֹיִ֖ם לֹ֥א יַחְמֽוֹל׃ס

controles.web: Will he therefore continually empty his net, and kill the nations without mercy?
controles.kjv: Shall they therefore empty their net, and not spare continually to slay the nations?
controles.livre: Continuará ele, pois, a esvaziar a sua malha, e a matar as nações continuamente sem ter compaixão?
